_comment: SKELETON of the real-pilot configuration manifest. It is intentionally incomplete and
unapproved: preflight refuses it as shipped (approved=false, pilotSchoolId=null, no grades,
no templates). Copy it to pc-pilot-v1.json once the decisions below are taken, fill it,
and have the digest approved before apply.
Field guide:
manifestVersion   lowercase slug; changing content means bumping the version.
mode              realPilot: installs approved non-PII configuration only.
target            realPilot (the production-class allowlist entry).
environmentClass  production; must match the allowlisted target.
approved          true only after the pilot review signs off on this exact digest.
scenarioEpoch     ISO timestamp recorded in the audit trail.
pilotSchoolId     integer schools.id of the pilot school (a reference, not PII).
grades[]          key (canonical grade slug), sortOrder + expectedName + isAlwaysGt
(must match the ab_grades row exactly), generationType, and the
migrationPlan entries (yearNumber 1-5, generationType GT|GI).
templates[]       one approved instrument per grade: key, gradeKey, area, name,
description, draftVersion (published as minor+1), scoringConfig
(optional), objectives -> modules -> indicators. Every frecuencia
indicator needs a complete frequencyConfig (min < max, step > 0,
unit, allowed_units). profundidad needs five levelDescriptors,
detalle needs detalleOptions. Every indicator declares GT
expectations (five yearly values) and GI when the grade is not
always-GT. Optional yearWeights per entity and year.
expectedCounts    the derived row counts; validation refuses a mismatch.
Never in this file: emails, names of real people, UUIDs, credentials, URLs,
docente-to-course bindings, course structures, transversal-context answers, minor data.
Docente bindings (if ever authorised) arrive at runtime from a gitignored input.
